# notes-app

A small notes service. See `PRODUCT_INTENT.md`.

## How work is done

- Do not implement anything that has no spec in `specs/`. Create one with `/sdd-specify` first.
- Features follow `/sdd-specify` → `/sdd-plan` → `/sdd-implement` → `/sdd-verify`.
- Claim a spec or task with `specs/_kit/sdd claim` before working on it.

| File | Read it for |
| --- | --- |
| `.claude/skills/sdd-*` | The six spec-kit skills |
